UPDATE person_identity pi JOIN person p ON p.workspace_id = pi.workspace_id AND p.id = pi.person_id SET pi.superseded_at = #{supersededAt} WHERE pi.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND pi.person_id = #{personId} AND pi.kind = 'email' AND pi.superseded_at IS NULL AND p.archived_at IS NULL AND p.suspended_at IS NULL AND p.provision_ceased_at IS NULL AND ( (p.email IS NULL AND #{rawValue,jdbcType=VARCHAR} IS NULL) OR CAST(p.email AS BINARY) = CAST(#{rawValue,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS BINARY) )
AND pi.normalized_value <> #{normalizedValue}

AND pi.normalized_value <> #{normalizedValue}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO person_identity ( workspace_id, person_id, kind, `value`, normalized_value, source_system, source_channel, source_external_id, source_row_ref, acquired_at, purpose_of_use_code ) SELECT p.workspace_id, p.id, 'email', #{rawValue}, #{normalizedValue}, #{sourceSystem}, 'person.email', NULL, #{sourceRowRef}, #{acquiredAt}, NULL FROM person p WHERE p.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND p.id = #{personId} AND CAST(p.email AS BINARY) = CAST(#{rawValue} AS BINARY) AND p.archived_at IS NULL AND p.suspended_at IS NULL AND p.provision_ceased_at IS NULL ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE superseded_at = NULL
